messages.subject: Meet and Analyze Data, 3:15pm-5:30pm, Wed, Oct 12th
parts:
Hello all,

this Wednesday, we will hold a “Meet and Analyze Data” session in the Bennett Room in the Center for Companion Animal Health (2nd floor).

(This is the general time/place for this meeting for the fall quarter.)

WHEN: 3:15pm, Wed, Oct 12th
WHERE: Bennett Room, 2nd floor CCAH, http://campusmap.ucdavis.edu/?b=33
WHAT: Meet! Analyze Data!

These sessions are intended to be a friendly co-working space for people who want to work on their data analysis, review data science tutorials, or otherwise hang out. Anyone seeking answers, sympathy, or companionship while working on data analysis, bioinformatics, or software development should feel free to come hang out!

We will provide caffeine in various forms, including coffee and tea.

this Wednesday, I will be out of town and Luiz Irber (CCed) will be coordinating.

best,
—titus
